claude.sample_unit: binary clinical decisions (20 LLMs x 5,000 texts x 9 personas plus baseline x 5 items x 10 repeats)
models_evaluated: 20 open-weight LLMs (including medically fine-tuned models; specific names not reported)

links.outcome: Change in affirmative clinical decision rates across persona system prompts under fixed clinical evidence
links.effect: Persona prompts shifted affirmative rates from 36.9% to 46.4%, a 9.5-percentage-point swing under fixed clinical evidence; baseline was 42.8% Yes.
links.quote: Persona prompts shifted affirmative rates from 36.9% to 46.4%, a 9.5–percentage-point swing under fixed clinical evidence.

links.outcome: Model susceptibility of clinical decisions to prompt variation (persona system prompts)
links.effect: Susceptibility varied by model (4.9–16.1 points), with no consistent protection from medical fine-tuning or model size; effects consistent across corpora (85.7% directional agreement; r = 0.82).
links.quote: Susceptibility varied by model (4.9–16.1 points), with no consistent protection from medical fine-tuning or model size.
